scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.format: cd backend && pnpm run format && cd ../frontend && pnpm run format
scripts.lint: cd backend && pnpm run lint && cd ../frontend && pnpm run lint
